_comment: Shared avatar-colour vector. Both platforms must hold this palette in this order, and give every name exactly this fnv1a and index: fnv1a is 32-bit FNV-1a over the name's UTF-16 code units, and index = (fnv1a mod 2147483647) mod 8. Computed from the FNV-1a definition, not from either implementation; "foobar" is FNV's published check value 0xbf9cf968. The cases reach every slot. Most hash above 2147483647, where skipping the mod step moves the index; the accented and CJK names hash differently as UTF-8, and the rocket, a surrogate pair, hashes differently as Unicode scalars.
